lines.en: label halloweenfour14:
scene raincheck
It’s raining tonight, but I’m the only one who notices it.
lines.zh: 今晚在下雨，但只有我注意到了。

lines.en: The rest move effortlessly between liquid droplets like they’re snowflakes, dodging whatever fucking shit I said last time in a similar fucking sentence because callbacks are poignant.
lines.zh: 其他人在雨滴间穿梭自如，就像那是雪花一样，躲避着我上次在类似的操蛋句子里说过的什么操蛋话，因为呼应是很动人的。

lines.en: {i}Sadness{/i} is poignant. It’s literally part of the definition. Which probably helps explain why I’m so fucking sad all the time because you wouldn’t be here if I wasn’t.
lines.zh: {i}悲伤{/i}是动人的。这几乎就写在定义里。这大概能解释为什么我他妈总是这么悲伤——因为如果我不悲伤，你就不会在这儿了。

lines.en: This is {i}your{/i} fault. It’s {i}your{/i} fault I’m about to lose everything. This never would have happened if you didn’t develop a fetish for watching me fail.
lines.zh: 这是{i}你{/i}的错。我就要失去一切了，是{i}你{/i}的错。如果你没有养成看我失败的癖好，这一切根本不会发生。

lines.en: And yes I deserve it. And yes the story will go on for {i}you.{/i} But will it really be the same when {i}I’m{/i} gone? What will you have left to watch? What will you have left to do?
lines.zh: 是的，我活该。是的，故事会为{i}你{/i}继续下去。但{i}我{/i}走了之后，它真的还会一样吗？你还剩下什么可看的？你还剩下什么可做的？

lines.en: My body is engulfed in the product of every element I can think of, but the only element I can think of is water — which is basically a flowery way for me to tell you I get wet.
lines.zh: 我的身体被我能想到的每一种元素的产物所吞没，而我唯一能想到的元素是水——这基本上只是我用一种花哨的方式告诉你：我湿了。

lines.en: Just not in the sort of manner you’re used to as getting wet in Kumon-mi more typically relates to the female body’s vaginal secretions and I feel as if my class is the one thing keeping the water cycle here circular.
lines.zh: 只是不是你习惯的那种方式，因为在 Kumon-mi，「湿」通常更常指女性身体的阴道分泌液，而我觉得我的课堂才是让这里的水循环保持循环的东西。

lines.en: Or at least it was until recently.
lines.zh: 或者至少在最近之前是。

lines.en: Something tells me it’s about to start raining a whole lot more.
lines.zh: 有种感觉告诉我，雨马上要大得多了。

lines.en: For more than just me.
lines.zh: 不只为我一个人。

lines.en: Something tells me everything is about to change, but it remains to be seen whether that’s for the better or worse.
lines.zh: 有种感觉告诉我，一切即将改变，但那是变好还是变坏，还有待观察。

lines.en: And when I say “something” I mean it’s been being whispered in my ears for a long time now.
lines.zh: 而当我说「有种感觉」，我的意思是，它已经在我耳边低语很久了。

lines.en: I’m good at ignoring things. You know that. I consider it one of my “special skills” right next to changing the size of my penis or manipulating reality in other fun and exciting ways.
lines.zh: 我很擅长无视东西。你知道的。我认为这是我的「特殊技能」之一，紧挨着改变我阴茎的大小、或者用其他有趣又刺激的方式操纵现实。

lines.en: But perhaps the reason I can’t ignore this any longer is that change is what I’m most terrified of.
lines.zh: 但也许我再也无法无视这件事的原因，是改变正是我最恐惧的东西。

lines.en: Perhaps this has become too much to bear.
lines.zh: 也许这已经变得让人承受不住了。

lines.en: I take another look around and see Ami...Maya...Ayane...Sana.
lines.zh: 我再环顾一圈，看见了 Ami……Maya……Ayane……Sana。

lines.en: We’re going out to karaoke.
lines.zh: 我们要去唱卡拉 OK。

lines.en: It’s Halloween, but it no longer feels like it as I recognize three of the four outfits they’re wearing while the one I {i}don’t{/i} recognize is on the body of a girl who’s practically burned into my mind at this point.
lines.zh: 今天是万圣节，可它已经不再像万圣节了，因为她们穿的四套衣服里我认得三套，而我{i}不{/i}认得的那套，穿在一个几乎已经烙进我脑子里的女孩身上。

lines.en: She stands out again — obnoxious, flashy, and impossible to look away from while {i}she{/i} has no trouble at all in looking away from everything that’s ever crossed her path.
lines.zh: 她又那么显眼——扎眼、招摇、让人无法移开目光，而{i}她{/i}却毫不费力就能把目光从曾出现在她生命里的一切上移开。

lines.en: A short-term memory infects my mind in reiterating that, if this could be my last night, I should make the most of it. I should try and be happy or...or whatever it was the one with the...the white hair...
lines.zh: 一段短时记忆感染了我的大脑，反复提醒我：如果这可能是我的最后一晚，我该好好利用它。我该试着快乐起来，或者……或者那个白头发的怎么说的来着……

lines.en: What was her name again?
lines.zh: 她叫什么名字来着？

lines.en: Oh well. It doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: 哦，算了。无所谓。

lines.en: Ami. Maya. Ayane. Sana.
lines.zh: Ami。Maya。Ayane。Sana。

lines.en: Those are the only names I need to remember right now, because they’re the last girls I’ll ever see.
lines.zh: 这些是我现在唯一需要记住的名字，因为她们是我最后能看见的女孩。

lines.en: It’s Halloween. We’re going out to karaoke.
lines.zh: 今天是万圣节。我们要去唱卡拉 OK。

lines.en: And the one thing I want more than anything else in the world right now is to be able to say that at least one more time next year.
lines.zh: 而此刻我在这个世界上最想要的，就是明年还能把这句话再说一遍。

lines.en: It wasn’t enough.
lines.zh: 这还不够。

lines.en: It was everything and it wasn’t enough.
lines.zh: 它就是一切，可它还不够。

lines.en: O world-
lines.zh: 哦，世界——

lines.en: Fuck you.
lines.zh: 去你的。

lines.en: scene karaoketime1
: So, should I knock Despacito out of the way now? Or should I save that for the finale? If I’m only allowed to do it once, I want to make sure I do it at the right time.
lines.zh: 那么，我现在就把《Despacito》先干掉？还是留到压轴？如果只能唱一次，我得确保用在对的时机。

lines.en: : How about you never sing it again for the rest of forever? Because I’ve heard it so many times by now that I’m pretty sure I can confidently say I know Spanish as a second language.
lines.zh: 要不你这辈子都别再唱了？因为到目前为止我已经听了太多次，我敢很自信地说，我的第二语言已经是西班牙语了。

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure this menu has changed since the last time we were here. There are significantly fewer things on it.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定这菜单跟上一次来的时候不一样了。上面少了很多东西。

lines.en: scene karaoketime2
: Oh no! Now you might have to order {i}two{/i} of everything instead of just handing the menu in at the front desk and saying “yes.”
lines.zh: 哦不！那你可能得把每样都点{i}两{/i}份，而不是直接把菜单交到前台说「好的」。

lines.en: : As if I would go all the way over there when there’s a perfectly functional phone in the room. As well as an Ami.
lines.zh: 好像我会特意跑过去似的，房间里明明有一台功能完好的电话。还有一个 Ami。

lines.en: : Am I not perfectly functional? Why does the phone get to be called “perfectly functional” but the Ami is just “Ami?”
lines.zh: 我难道功能不够完好吗？凭什么电话能被叫做「功能完好」，而 Ami 就只是「Ami」？

lines.en: scene karaoketime3

: Don’t worry, Ami. {i}I{/i} think you’re perfectly functional. You’re just also...{i}not{/i} sometimes! But that’s totally fine because I’m the one paying for everything tonight, which makes my word law.
lines.zh: 别担心，Ami。{i}我{/i}觉得你功能很完好。你只是有时候也……{i}不太{/i}完好！不过完全没关系，因为今晚是我买单，所以我说的话就是法律。

lines.en: : And why exactly were you dead-set on doing this again? The food at your house was significantly better than what they have here and it’s strange to me that everyone is still there despite us...not being there.
lines.zh: 那你到底为什么非要再来这一出？你家的饭菜比这里的强多了，而且奇怪的是我们……不在这儿了，大家却还待在那儿。

lines.en: : Because that’s what we {i}always{/i} do! And it’s way more dangerous leaving Sensei in a room full of girls in costumes than girls in {i}normal{/i} clothes, which is what we’ll be wearing during Christmas.
lines.zh: 因为我们{i}一直{/i}都是这么做的！再说，把 Sensei 留在一屋子穿着变装的女孩中间，比留在穿{i}平常{/i}衣服的女孩中间危险多了，而圣诞节时她们穿的就是后者。

lines.en: : Everyone except Chika, you mean. I’m pretty sure I heard her mention breaking out her dollar store Santa outfit again. Just not in those exact words.
lines.zh: 你是说除了 Chika 以外的所有人。我好像听到她提过又要翻出她那套一元店的圣诞老人装。虽然不是原话。

lines.en: : Guys, I’m doing this to protect not only {i}my{/i} sacred love for Sensei, but to strengthen our bond as the Love Squad! And to protect {i}your{/i} sacred loves as well, I guess.
lines.zh: 各位，我这么做不只是为了保护{i}我{/i}对 Sensei 神圣的爱，也是为了巩固我们作为「恋爱小队」的羁绊！还有，我猜也是为了保护{i}你们{/i}神圣的爱。

lines.en: : Well, whatever you’re doing, do it quietly.
lines.zh: 行吧，不管你要做什么，小声点。

lines.en: scene karaoketime4
: I’m not sure how exactly you expect me to sing quietly, but I will do my best!
lines.zh: 我不太确定你指望我怎么「小声地」唱歌，不过我会尽力的！

lines.en: : And I won’t because that sounds boring! Now, let’s pick a song while Maya tries to convince herself that two of every food item is enough.
lines.zh: 我才不会，因为那听起来很无聊！现在，趁 Maya 还在说服自己每样食物点两份就够了，我们来选首歌吧。

lines.en: : Does this mean...I’m a member of the...um...Love Squad now?...
lines.zh: 这是不是意味着……我现在也是……嗯……恋爱小队的一员了？……

lines.en: : You’ve been a member all along Sana! You just haven’t accepted it in your heart yet.
lines.zh: 你从头到尾都是啊，Sana！只是你心里还没接受而已。

lines.en: scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit36
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit37
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit36
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit37
scene karaoketime4
: Hold on a second. Shouldn’t we take a vote or something? There are three members of the Sensei Love Squad and I think at least the majority should be on board before-
lines.zh: 等等。我们不该投个票什么的吗？Sensei 恋爱小队有三名成员，我觉得至少得过半数同意才能-

lines.en: : Nope! I already said my word is law because I’m paying for everything tonight. So, with this decree, Sana is officially a member of the Love Squad! Hooray for Sana!
lines.zh: 不！我已经说了，我说的话就是法律，因为今晚我买单。所以，凭此敕令，Sana 正式成为恋爱小队成员！为 Sana 欢呼！

lines.en: : Um...uhh...thank you?...
: I’m...not really sure what to...think about that...
lines.zh: 我……不太确定该……怎么想这件事……

lines.en: scene karaoketime5
: Um...do you...need something...Sensei?...
lines.zh: 嗯……你……有什么事吗……Sensei？……

lines.en: There’s no way what happened earlier was just...in my head, is there?
lines.zh: 之前发生的事不可能只是……我的幻觉，对吧？

lines.en: Because there’s clearly a lot going on inside of me today and...it would make sense if it {i}was.{/i} Especially considering how I can barely remember any of it and-
lines.zh: 因为我今天心里显然有很多事在翻涌，而且……如果{i}是{/i}幻觉，那也说得通。尤其是考虑到我几乎记不清其中的任何细节，而且-

lines.en: And come to think of it, I haven’t seen...uh...
lines.zh: 而且这么一想，我从那之后就没再见过……呃……

lines.en: I haven’t seen...the...
lines.zh: 我没再见过……那个……

lines.en: The other girl who was there since then either.
lines.zh: 那个当时也在场的另一个女孩。

lines.en: : Sensei, stop creepily staring at Sana and tell us what song to sing.
lines.zh: Sensei，别再诡异地盯着 Sana 看了，告诉我们唱哪首歌。

lines.en: : Oh, shush. He’s probably just still worried about her after the whole fainting episode from earlier. But, speaking of which- how are you feeling now, Sana? Are you okay? Do you want some water?
lines.zh: 哦，嘘。他大概只是还在为她之前晕倒的事担心。不过，说到这个——你现在感觉怎么样，Sana？还好吗？要不要喝点水？

lines.en: scene karaoketime6
: I’m okay...I already have a drink...
lines.zh: 我没事……我已经有喝的了……

lines.en: : And Sensei was...a really big help earlier...
lines.zh: 而且 Sensei 之前……帮了我很大的忙……

lines.en: scene karaoketime7
: He took...very good care of me...
lines.zh: 他……把我照顾得很好……

lines.en: A small hand comes to rest on my right thigh...
lines.zh: 一只小手搭上了我的右大腿……

lines.en: And I remember it all.
lines.zh: 然后我全都想起来了。

lines.en: scene karaoketime8
I remember the hot, stickiness of her skin and the ridges of her ribcage as my fingers brushed them while tracing her body.
lines.zh: 我想起她皮肤滚烫的黏腻，想起我的手指描摹她身体时擦过的肋骨轮廓。

lines.en: I remember her soft, almost pained moans as she grabbed my wrist and forced me downward.
lines.zh: 我想起她柔软、几乎带着痛意的呻吟，想起她抓住我的手腕，用力往下按。

lines.en: I remember her breath...How she kept trying to look me in the eyes.
lines.zh: 我想起她的呼吸……想起她一直试图与我对视。

lines.en: How she fumbled with the button on my jeans and the fervor with which she stroked me when finally managing to undo it.
lines.zh: 想起她笨拙地解着我牛仔裤的纽扣，以及终于解开之后，她抚弄我时的那股急切。

lines.en: The squelching sound when my fingers entered her body and the puddle left behind when all was said and done.
lines.zh: 想起我的手指进入她身体时那声黏腻的水响，以及一切结束之后留下的那摊水渍。

lines.en: How it was easier to get inside than I thought it would be for a girl of her size.
lines.zh: 想起以她那样的身量，进去竟比我想象的要容易。

lines.en: How thankful she was that I’d done that.
lines.zh: 想起她对我做那件事有多感激。

lines.en: And how we were watched the entire time.
lines.zh: 还有，我们全程都被人看着。

lines.en: : It’s a shame Makoto couldn’t make it. I was really hoping she’d be here.
lines.zh: Makoto 没能来真可惜。我真的很希望她能在这儿。

lines.en: : Why? She has glasses and glasses are stupid.
lines.zh: 为什么？她戴眼镜，而眼镜很蠢。

lines.en: scene karaoketime9
: No offense, Sensei.
lines.zh: 无意冒犯，Sensei。

lines.en: A small hand stops resting on my right thigh and goes back to where it belongs — anywhere else.
lines.zh: 一只小手不再搭在我的右大腿上，回到了它该在的地方——别的任何地方。

lines.en: : I can’t blame her for rejecting your invitation. Especially when your “karaoke tendencies” exited the rumor stage a long time ago and are now just a step or two away from being deemed an urban legend.
lines.zh: 我怪不得她拒绝你的邀请。尤其是你的「卡拉 OK 倾向」早就过了谣言阶段，现在离被认定为都市传说也就一两步之遥了。

lines.en: : I’ve always wanted to be an urban legend, I just never expected it to be due to my superb taste in music.
lines.zh: 我一直想成为一个都市传说，只是没想到会是因为我在音乐上的绝佳品味。

lines.en: : Hey, just out of curiosity, did something happen between you two?
lines.zh: 嘿，只是好奇，你们俩之间是不是发生了什么？

lines.en: scene karaoketime10
: Huh?...What do you mean?...
lines.zh: 啊？……你是什么意思？……

lines.en: : Yeah, what {i}do{/i} you mean? They seem normal to me.
lines.zh: 对啊，你{i}到底{/i}是什么意思？我看他们很正常啊。

lines.en: : I just think it’s a little weird how Sana’s the one sitting next to Sensei and not any of us. And that she smiled at him when she said he took “very good care of her.”
lines.zh: 我只是觉得有点怪：坐在 Sensei 旁边的是 Sana，而不是我们中的任何一个。而且她说他「把我照顾得很好」的时候还冲他笑了。

lines.en: : And that he hasn’t really said anything since we got here and is kind of just existing like a big blob on the opposite side of the table.
lines.zh: 还有，我们从来到这儿之后他基本一句话都没说过，就像一大坨东西瘫在桌子对面。

lines.en: scene karaoketime11
: Have you been...drinking enough water?...Do you...want me to...come with you to the...vending machine?...
lines.zh: 你……水喝够了吗？……要不要我……陪你去……自动售货机？……

lines.en: : That. That’s what I’m talking about. That’s weird.
lines.zh: 就是这个。我说的就是这个。这很怪。

lines.en: : Ami, calm down. You’re just imagining things. Sana and Sensei aren’t like that.
lines.zh: Ami，冷静点。你在脑补而已。Sana 和 Sensei 不是那种关系。

lines.en: scene karaoketime12
: Hahah! You’re probably right! Sensei would never see anyone other than {i}us{/i} three as potential partners! Right, Sensei?!
lines.zh: 哈哈哈哈！你大概是对的！Sensei 绝不会把{i}我们{/i}三个以外的人当成潜在对象！对吧，Sensei？！

lines.en: : Um...aren’t you two...
lines.zh: 嗯……你们两个不是……

lines.en: : Yup! And?
lines.zh: 对啊！怎么了？

lines.en: : Okaaaaaay! Time to stop whatever is happening right now so we can have a fun, relaxing time where nothing goes wrong!
lines.zh: 好——了！现在就停下手头正在发生的一切，好让我们度过一段什么都不出错的、轻松快乐的时光！

lines.en: scene karaoketime13
: Whoops! Must have forgotten which Ami I am for a second! Hahah!
lines.zh: 哎呀！我大概是有一瞬间忘了自己是哪个 Ami！哈哈哈！

lines.en: : No worries, Ami! Now, tell the crowd what our first song of the night will be!
lines.zh: 没事，Ami！现在，告诉全场我们今晚的第一首歌是什么！

lines.en: : This one’s called “Shining Star” by Niki Nakayama! And we hope you’ll all sing along!
lines.zh: 这首叫「Shining Star」，由 Niki Nakayama 演唱！希望大家一起唱！

lines.en: scene karaoketime14
: Well, would you look at that? It seems as if my appetite has mysteriously vanished.
lines.zh: 哟，你瞧？我的胃口似乎神奇地消失了。

lines.en: : Are you...also not a fan of...music like this, Maya?...
lines.zh: Maya 也……不太喜欢……这种音乐吗？……

lines.en: : Something like that.
lines.zh: 差不多吧。

lines.en: : Not everyone can be blessed with great taste like me!
lines.zh: 不是每个人都能像我一样被赐予绝佳的品味！

lines.en: : And also me!
lines.zh: 还有我！

lines.en: : Not so much!
lines.zh: 你就差远了！

lines.en: : I don’t...um...think I’ve ever asked before but...but what kind of...music do you normally...listen to if...if it’s not the same as...um...
lines.zh: 我……嗯……好像从来没问过，但是……但是你平时……都听什么样的……音乐，如果……如果不是和……嗯……一样的话……

lines.en: scene karaoketime15
: Classical, mostly. But it’s not as if you can come to a karaoke bar and sing Moonlight Sonata.
lines.zh: 主要是古典乐。不过你总不能跑到卡拉 OK 吧去唱《月光奏鸣曲》。

lines.en: : Don’t let Maya fool you! She’s actually an amazing singer. Just...not in songs without lyrics, obviously.
lines.zh: 别被 Maya 骗了！她其实唱得非常棒。只是……显然在无歌词的曲子里不行。

lines.en: scene karaoketime16
: I’m fine, I suppose.
lines.zh: 我还行吧，大概。

lines.en: : {i}Just{/i} fine? Are you not in a bragging mood today or something? That’s the least conceited you’ve sounded in all the years I’ve known you.
lines.zh: {i}只是{/i}还行？你今天是没心情吹牛还是怎么的？认识你这么多年，这还是你最不自负的一次。

lines.en: scene karaoketime17
: Yes, I suppose I’m not “in a bragging mood.” So please, feel free to sing your obnoxious idol music while I continue to peruse the menu.
lines.zh: 是的，我大概是「没心情吹牛」。所以请随意唱你们那吵死人的偶像音乐吧，我继续研究菜单。

lines.en: : You heard her, Ami! Let’s get this party started and show Sensei that Niki’s not the only idol who can get his heart pumping!
lines.zh: 你听到她说的了，Ami！让我们把派对开起来，让 Sensei 看看 Niki 不是唯一能让他心跳加速的偶像！

lines.en: : Okay, but I’m restarting the song since we were talking over the first verse and I refuse to disrespect my queen like that.
lines.zh: 好吧，不过我要把歌重新放一遍，因为第一段被我们说话盖过去了，我可不愿意那样不尊重我的女王。

lines.en: The song starts again and I’m immediately flooded by an outpouring of nostalgic memories and the desire to reach into my pocket for-
lines.zh: 歌又响了起来，我立刻被汹涌而出的怀旧记忆淹没，还有一种想把手伸进口袋去掏-
